verdict.rationale: Gemini's own structured-output docs (Portuguese and Japanese) say the models can be configured to generate responses that adhere to a provided JSON schema. The quickstart also lists structured output as a core capability, which covers the JSON-schema-constrained branch of the story. Missing for 10: detail on SDK-native typed output (e.g. class/type-to-schema binding) and supported schema features or limits, plus independent or hands-on confirmation that outputs reliably conform.

support.subject: As a developer, I can get typed, structured outputs — JSON-schema-constrained responses or a natively typed answer format — so my code consumes model output without fragile parsing

citations.quote: É possível configurar os modelos do Gemini para gerar respostas que aderem a um esquema JSON fornecido.
指定された JSON スキーマに準拠したレスポンスを生成するように Gemini モデルを構成できます。
